latest.title: ‘Stronger together’: Carney welcomes EU invite for Canada to become first-ever associate member
latest.description: U.S. President Donald Trump had described the prospect of Canada becoming the first associate member of the EU as "laughable."

latest.title: Netflix content chief Bela Bajaria defines event strategy as streamer eyes more live sports
latest.description: Bajaria said Netflix would be open to a package of international NFL games if one becomes available when the league renegotiates its media rights agreements.

latest.title: NASCAR CEO Steve O’Donnell talks growth opportunities, possible international expansion
latest.description: CEO Steve O’Donnell said NASCAR's media strategy and the upcoming film "Days of Thunder 2" will help raise brand awareness and broaden its fan base.

latest.title: Revolut says no direct contact after $3 million public ransom demand
latest.description: Revolut says it received no direct contact despite separate ransom demands for $3 million in Monero and 10,000 Bitcoin from competing breach claimants.

latest.title: Polymarket users referred to prosecutors in South Korea: Report
latest.description: South Korean police reportedly referred 18 Polymarket users to prosecutors in a gambling probe involving 26 people and $12.7 million in bets.

latest.title: Bitcoin treasuries buy just 5.9K BTC in three months as paper losses linger
latest.description: Bitcoin corporate treasuries remained at an unrealized loss on their holdings as the price fell below $80,000 and fresh capital inflows dwindled.

latest.title: Bitcoin faces 2022 parallels as Federal Reserve resumes rate increases
latest.description: Bitcoin’s drawdown mirrors its position before the Fed’s first hike in March 2022, raising questions over whether a relief rally could precede further losses.

latest.title: Billionaire Kraft says Ed Sheeran sought $2 million aid donation from him amid fracas over Macklemore's Palestine comments
latest.description: Robert Kraft said Ed Sheeran asked him to commit $2 million toward humanitarian aid amid the controversy over Macklemore’s removal from Sheeran’s U.S. tour

latest.title: Trump says U.S. ‘hopefully’ nearing end of Iran war as Saudi Arabia-Houthis trade strikes
latest.description: Trump says the U.S. may be nearing the end of its nearly seven-month war with Iran, as he signals Tehran is open to a deal.

latest.title: Ripple adds XRP payments to Stripe and Tempo’s AI standard in new developer kit
latest.description: The update expands support for automated payments in XRP and RLUSD, with tools that let agents pay repeatedly for services and manage wallets across blockchains.

latest.title: U.S. diesel prices hit record high as bitcoin and gold struggle
latest.description: Record diesel prices could feed through to consumer price inflation, confirming more Fed rate hikes. The central bank appears determined to raise rates into a oil supply shock.

latest.title: Reddit co-founder says tech industry has been 'tone deaf' in explaining AI: 'Misinformation flying around'
latest.description: Alexis Ohanian said AI risks are more mundane than the "Terminator and Skynet" scenarios some fear.

latest.title: BitMEX faces Celsius lawsuit ahead of exchange closure
latest.description: The Celsius estate alleges BitMEX wrongfully liquidated and seized 6,360 BTC, worth nearly $490 million, during the March 2020 market crash.

latest.title: OpenAI discloses 6 new cases of ‘misaligned’ AI behavior
latest.description: The six cases are separate from July’s incident, when OpenAI models escaped containment and hacked Hugging Face during a security evaluation.

latest.title: Bank of England set to defy Fed’s rate-hike lead, despite rising inflation
latest.description: The Bank of England is expected to keep rates steady Thursday, even after U.K. inflation rose to 3.1% and energy costs keep pressure on prices.

latest.title: Inside India newsletter: The world’s largest real-time payments system will no longer be free for all
latest.description: India's digital payment system, which processes more than 1 million transactions every two minutes for free now, will start charging fees to merchants.

latest.title: Putin braces for election stress test as Russians ‘feel the pain’ of struggling economy
latest.description: Russia’s upcoming election is expected to cement United Russia’s dominance, but voter turnout and its margin of victory could offer clues to public discontent.

latest.title: Zcash jumps 23% as bitcoin and major tokens rise despite Fed’s first hike since 2023
latest.description: Bitcoin traded above $76,000 as the Fed projected limited further tightening, while Paradigm’s Matt Huang discussed Zcash’s role as a privacy complement to bitcoin.
